historical_diagnosis.source_mismatch_mechanism: Hybrid chunk ID combines another document's prefix with the selected row's span/suffix and exact digest. Current context hash matches; not stale evidence.
historical_diagnosis.length_note: Both reached1024 output tokens and4000 content UTF8 bytes, rejected before output parsing. Three available refs serialize well below that limit; copying is not established as the cause.

hypothesis: A compound optional wire treatment using current-request source indices and decision-specific minimal fields can reduce reference-copy and schema mistakes, with shorter outputs. Compare the package, not causal contributions of its components; length improvement is unproven.

implementation.wire_sources: Exact zero-based integer source indices of the current validated request.evidence.hits. No cached/global mapping or model-supplied mapping.
implementation.source_expansion: After existing provider envelope/model/usage settlement checks, map selected indices to exact canonical chunk_id/content_sha256 from that same validated request and revalidate GroundedPlan. Retain full context_sha256 matching and unchanged renderer/approval.
implementation.integrity_tradeoff: Per-source digests are generated locally from the selected current record rather than independently echoed by the model. Full current request digest binds the selection; this does not authenticate source truth or establish relevance.
implementation.failure_policy: Malformed JSON/shape is invalid_grounded_plan within the existing repair allowance. Wrong full context hash and unknown integer source index remain terminal binding errors. Do not salvage truncated output or silently drop fields/sources.
implementation.observability: Preserve separately named allowlisted raw-wire hash/shape/rejection diagnostics, including rejected expansion. Canonical output observations do not count as raw provider format compliance.

offline_acceptance: Default/false prompts and gateway outputs preserve historical bytes.
Canonical and indexed source selection render equal full outputs for every decision and renderer mode.
Current request binding rejects stale correction, reordered/changed evidence, wrong hash, unknown negative/out-of-range integer choices; no stale mapping reuse.
Strict JSON rejects duplicate keys, NaN, fences, oversized/invalid Unicode, booleans/floats/mixed refs, repeated selections, extra or decision-ineligible fields.
Conflict continuity, complete quotation, source-capacity composition and caller-owned counters remain enforced.
Malformed-first/valid-second mock uses exactly two sends; binding mismatch and provider length stop after one settled send.
Raw-wire diagnostics remain visible after expansion failure without raw unknown names/messages/keys.
All archived actual/repair prompts fit the same32768 input guard; no increased allowance.

planned_live_comparison.common_flags: decision_contracts,source_selection_reminder,source_gap_handoff,source_gap_investigation,repeated-query repair ON; source_capacity and resource_guidance OFF
planned_live_comparison.ordering: First round A/B/C; second C/B/A; arm order balanced within each family.
outcomes: raw-wire schema validity separate from canonical expansion
provider length stops and actual output tokens
actual source support and necessary answerable questions
planned_live_comparison.interpretation: Small exposed answer-informed dev study, not held-out/final evaluation or proof of RAG quality. Fewer structural errors or more escalations do not establish answer usefulness. Human usefulness remains unscored.
planned_live_comparison.stop_policy: Fresh finite identities only after source/input/index/full-ledger preflight. Preserve both old uncertain holds, global halt, USD4.50 ceiling and old revocations. New uncertainty, unexplained accounting or changed source/input stops the whole campaign; never replace/resume closed identities.

reference_limit: Official OpenAI schema guidance does not establish third-party Metis support. No response_format or transport parameter is introduced in this treatment.
